coverage.method: Director Compensation tables from every definitive proxy filed 2019-2026 (DEF 14A 2019-10-16, 2020-10-19, 2021-10-14, 2022-10-27, 2023-10-19, 2024-10-24, 2025-10-21), one table per fiscal year FY2019-FY2025 (years end June 30; confirmed on each 10-K cover FY2019-FY2026): 84 rows (13, 14, 11, 11, 11, 13, 11). Every table has Fees Earned or Paid in Cash, Stock Awards, All Other Compensation and Total columns; option, non-equity incentive and pension/NQDC are recorded as 0, and every row's components equal its printed total. Blank All Other cells (2023 and 2024 tables) are recorded as 0. Satya Nadella, the only employee director, is excluded by the proxies (no director pay); William H. Gates III is listed with zeros in FY2019 and FY2020 (waived). Checked with no director table: all 13 DEFA14As filed 2019-2025. No PRE 14A or 10-K/A was filed in the period, and no 2026 DEF 14A had been filed by 2026-09-17 (last filing in the feed fetched 2026-10-14), so FY2026 is not covered.
